export declare const MATERIALS_CURSOR_MAX = 24000;

export declare const MATERIALS_PORTS: Readonly<{
    readonly files: "files";
    readonly before: "before";
    readonly after: "after";
    readonly selection: "selection";
}>;

export declare const MATERIALS_PROVIDER_ID = "system.materials";

export declare const MATERIALS_SURFACE = "materials";

export declare const MATERIAL_ORIGINS_COMPARE = 5;

export declare const MATERIAL_ORIGINS_MAX = 20;

export declare const MATERIAL_ORIGIN_ANSWER_SCHEMA: ActionSchema;

export declare const MATERIAL_ORIGIN_NOTES: {
    readonly unchecked: "内容没有核对";
    readonly former_default_output: "这个项目原来的默认输出目录";
    readonly other_default_output: "另一台设备的默认输出目录";
};

export declare const MATERIAL_ORIGIN_QUERY_SCHEMA: ActionSchema;

export declare const MATERIAL_ORIGIN_SCHEMA: ActionSchema;

export declare const MATERIAL_RECENT_KEEP = 20;

export declare const MATERIAL_RECENT_RECORD_MAX = 10;

export declare const MATERIAL_REF_LIMITS: {
    readonly subject_kind: 200;
    readonly subject_id: 16584;
    readonly revision: 1000;
    readonly artifact_id: 200;
    readonly anchor: 200;
};

export declare const MATERIAL_REF_SCHEMA: ActionSchema;

export interface MaterialOrigin {
    source: "directory" | "import" | "object";
    owner: {
        kind: "plugin" | "system";
        id: string;
        title: string;
    };
    directory?: {
        workspace_id: string;
        display_name: string;
        roles: DirectoryRole[];
    };
    state: "ok" | "changed" | "missing" | "forbidden" | "truncated" | "unreadable" | "unmapped";
    note?: string;
}

export interface MaterialOriginAnswer {
    origin: MaterialOrigin | null;
}

export type MaterialOriginQuery = {
    ref: MaterialRef;
} | {
    subject: ActionSubject;
};

export type MaterialPin = {
    mode: "current";
    read_revision: string;
} | {
    mode: "fixed";
    version: ArtifactReference;
} | {
    mode: "snapshot";
    version: ArtifactReference;
};

export interface MaterialRange {
    anchor?: string;
    line?: number;
    length?: number;
    page?: number;
}

export interface MaterialRef {
    subject: ActionSubject;
    pin: MaterialPin;
    range?: MaterialRange;
}

export interface MaterialsCaptureInput {
    workspace_id: string;
    path: readonly string[];
    fingerprint?: string;
    cursor?: string;
    port?: MaterialsCapturePort;
    start?: number;
    end?: number;
}

export type MaterialsCapturePort = "before" | "after" | "selection";

export interface MaterialsCaptureResult {
    ref: MaterialRef;
    port: MaterialsCapturePort | null;
    snapshot: FileSnapshot | FileTextSelection;
}

export interface MaterialsOpenInput {
    workspace_id: string;
    path: readonly string[];
}

export interface MaterialsOpenResult {
    workspace: MaterialsWorkspace;
    result: WorkspaceFileResult;
    path: readonly string[];
}

export type MaterialsPort = typeof MATERIALS_PORTS[keyof typeof MATERIALS_PORTS];

export interface MaterialsPosition {
    workspace_id: string;
    path: readonly string[];
}

export interface MaterialsReadInput {
    ref: MaterialRef;
    mode: "head" | "text";
    cursor?: string;
}

export interface MaterialsReadResult {
    ref: MaterialRef;
    title: string;
    read_revision: string;
    comparable: boolean;
    state: "ok" | "changed";
    text?: string;
    selection?: {
        start: number;
        end: number;
    };
    window?: MaterialsReadWindow;
}

export interface MaterialsReadWindow {
    start: number;
    cursor: string;
    next_cursor: string | null;
}

export interface MaterialsWorkspace {
    workspace_id: string;
    name: string;
    handle: string;
}

export interface RecentMaterial {
    ref: MaterialRef;
    origin: MaterialOrigin | null;
}

export declare const SYSTEM_MATERIALS_PRODUCER_VERSION = "1";

export declare const SYSTEM_MATERIALS_SOURCE: SystemOutputSource;

export declare const SYSTEM_OUTPUT_SOURCES: readonly SystemOutputSource[];

export declare const materialsActions: {
    open: ActionDefinition<MaterialsOpenInput, MaterialsOpenResult>;
    capture: ActionDefinition<MaterialsCaptureInput, MaterialsCaptureResult>;
    read: ActionDefinition<MaterialsReadInput, MaterialsReadResult>;
    position: ActionDefinition<Record<string, never>, {
        position: MaterialsPosition | null;
    }>;
};

export declare const materialsFileSource: {
    entries: ActionDefinition<import("platform/file-sources").FileEntriesInput, import("platform/file-sources").FileEntriesPage>;
    content: ActionDefinition<import("platform/file-sources").FileContentInput, import("platform/file-sources").FileContent>;
};

export declare const systemOutputSource: (pluginId: string) => SystemOutputSource | undefined;
